instrument: County Judge Barry Hyde veto letter, Ordinance No. 26-OR-19 / 26-I-56B (Sept 25, 2026)
summary: Vetoes the data center ordinance under Amendment 55 and Ark. Code 14-14-911, citing: (1) vested-rights exposure under Article 17 for projects lacking Final County Approvals (Blundell v. City of West Helena; Potter v. City of Tontitown) and limits on local authority under Ark. Code 23-119-105(f) and AG Op. 2023-060; (2) Article 9 appeals conflicting with Ark. Code 14-17-203(g) and MMSC, LLC v. Washington County (2026); (3) an unfunded administrative program whose monitoring fee requires a separate fee ordinance; (4) forgone tax base; (5) litigation and immunity risk (RCM Hill, LLC v. Hill County, Texas).

source.citation: Letter to Pulaski County Clerk Terri Hollingsworth, filed Sept 25, 2026 16:30, 6 pp.

notes: Reporting that the Quorum Court bypassed the planning commission (THV11) is not supported by the letter. Override date not stated in the letter.
text: For these reasons, I veto Ordinance No. 26-OR-19.
